title: Chapter 8: Syzygy Low Tide & The Three-Hour Glass Reef Window (Stardate 49603.1)
summary: When the shepherd moons Lumen and Umbra align vertically beneath Vespera's rings, the purple ocean recedes for a strict three-hour window matching Ryan's Protocol T-10 clock—revealing a mirror-smooth bio-silica crystal seabed whose spiral tide-pools store and replay the harmonic songs of the Chorus-Rays.
